individual-data-points.explanation: Panel shows representative localization/trajectory reconstructions, not a summary plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel is a set of microscopy-derived localization/trajectory images, not a plot.

individual-data-points.explanation: The histogram shows the full distribution of diffusion coefficients pooled from all molecules/cells, and the MSD plot shows individual trajectory lines, so neither requires an additional overlay of individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Neither the diffusion coefficient histogram nor the mean square displacement line plot contains error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Trajectories and kymograph display individual raw molecule trajectories directly, equivalent to a line plot of individual traces, so no further individual-point overlay is required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The trajectory and kymograph displays contain no error bars.
